subtitle: Keep your guitar safe, accessible, and ready to play. From portable stands to permanent wall hangers, discover the best storage solutions for every situation.

introduction.title: Why Proper Storage Matters
introduction.text: A good stand keeps your guitar safe, accessible, and ready to play at a moment's notice. Proper storage prevents accidents, protects your instrument's finish, and encourages more frequent practice.

columns.title: Protection Benefits
columns.text: Fall Prevention: Secure positioning prevents accidents. Finish Protection: Padded contact points prevent damage. Neck Support: Proper angle prevents neck stress. Environmental: Keeps guitar off floor, away from hazards. Organization: Dedicated space for each instrument.

columns.title: Convenience & Access
columns.text: Quick Access: Guitar always ready to play. Practice Motivation: Visible instrument encourages playing. Space Efficiency: Organized storage saves room. Display Value: Show off your instruments. Workflow: Seamless practice and performance setup.

cards.title: A-Frame Stands
cards.description: Foldable design, lightweight, adjustable width with rubber padding. Good stability with excellent portability.

fields.label: Pros
fields.value: Very portable, affordable, universal fit, easy setup

fields.label: Cons
fields.value: Less stable, single guitar only, can tip over, basic protection

fields.label: Best For
fields.value: Home practice, travel, temporary setups, budget solution

cards.title: Tripod Stands
cards.description: Three-leg base with adjustable height, locking mechanisms and auto-grip yokes. Very good stability with good portability.

fields.label: Pros
fields.value: Very stable, height adjustable, secure grip, professional grade

fields.label: Cons
fields.value: Bulkier, more expensive, single instrument, longer setup time

fields.label: Best For
fields.value: Stage performance, studio use, valuable instruments, professional settings

cards.title: Multi-Guitar Stands
cards.description: Multiple slots with heavy base, protective padding and stable platform. Excellent stability but poor portability.

fields.label: Pros
fields.value: Multiple guitars, very stable, space efficient, organization

fields.label: Cons
fields.value: Not portable, expensive, takes floor space, heavy

fields.label: Best For
fields.value: Studios, music rooms, guitar collections, permanent setups

cards.title: Wall Hangers
cards.description: Wall mounted with auto-grip mechanism, protective padding and space saving design. Excellent stability with no portability.

fields.label: Pros
fields.value: Saves floor space, secure mounting, display value, multiple options

fields.label: Cons
fields.value: Permanent installation, wall damage risk, height limitations, access issues

fields.label: Best For
fields.value: Permanent display, space saving, guitar collections, wall decoration

cards.title: Basic Hook Hangers
cards.description: Simple hook design with manual placement and basic padding. Low security - requires careful placement, risk of falling.

cards.title: Auto-Grip Hangers
cards.description: Automatic locking with weight-activated grip and release mechanism. High security - guitar locked in place.

cards.title: Hercules Hangers
cards.description: AGS (Auto Grip System) with professional grade build and instant lock/release. Very high security - industry standard.

cards.title: Installation Considerations
items: Wall Type: Drywall, plaster, concrete, brick
Stud Location: Use stud finder for secure mounting
Weight Capacity: Check hanger rating vs. guitar weight
Height Placement: Consider accessibility and safety
Spacing: Allow clearance between multiple hangers
Level Installation: Use level for straight mounting

cards.title: Safety Guidelines
items: Proper Anchors: Use appropriate wall anchors
Weight Limits: Don't exceed manufacturer specs
Backup Support: Wall studs for heavy guitars

cards.title: Joe Bonamassa
cards.description: Multiple Hercules multi-guitar stands. Professional touring setup with secure, quick-access stands.

cards.title: Eric Clapton
cards.description: Studio wall hangers and tripod stands. Combination of display and performance-ready setups.

cards.title: John Mayer
cards.description: Premium tripod stands for stage. High-end stands for valuable vintage guitars during live shows.

cards.title: Guitar Center Stores
cards.description: Wall hanging display systems. Retail environment showcasing guitars while keeping them secure.

cards.title: Optimal Placement
items: Away from Traffic: Avoid high-activity areas
Good Lighting: Easy to see and access
Clear Space: Room for safe movement

cards.title: Maintenance Schedule
items: Quarterly: Inspect all connections and joints
Annually: Deep clean and lubricate mechanisms
As Needed: Replace worn padding or parts
